text:
Maya P.: Quick sync — we need to finalize the operational flow for the SI embedded systems onboarding (hardware + marketplace listing). Pilot with Orion SI is go, but they asked for clear lab access, cert badge, and a lightweight exam.
Kevin L.: Nice. What are the hard blockers?
Maya P.: Two things: voucher distribution for on-prem lab GPUs, and approvals for a marketplace joint announcement (legal + marketing). Also localization of the hands-on labs for EMEA partners.
Jessie R.: For vouchers — can we reuse the existing HW-voucher workflow? I remember infra had a script: ```/scripts/grant-voucher --si "Orion" --qty 5 --expires 2024-06-30``` We might need per-region SKUs though.
Rahul S.: Region SKUs is the catch. On-prem lab racks are in us-west and eu-central. Need to tag vouchers by region and set IP allowlist. I can add a small endpoint to the voucher service to accept region param. ETA 72h.
Maya P.: Thanks Rahul. Kevin, can you own marketplace listing approvals? Marketing needs the blurb + logo + joint PR timeline.
Kevin L.: I can take that. I'll sync with marketing and legal. Suggest we keep the PR to a soft blog post the week after training so docs are ready.
Jessie R.: On certification: propose two pillars — (1) Hands-on lab completion (we track by lab artifact uploads), (2) 30-min oral/quiz for architecture and ops. Passing yields "Redwood SI Embedded Certified" badge. Anyone against that? :thinking_face:
Maya P.: I like that. We should limit the oral to 30 mins and record consented sessions for quality calibration. Also need to create a short syllabus.
Rahul S.: For lab artifact tracking we can use the existing S3 bucket + a small manifest json. Example artifact path: `s3://si-onboard/orion/2024-05/labs/board-1/manifest.json`. We can auto-validate checksum and required fields.
Jessie R.: I'll draft the syllabus template tonight. Basic modules: hardware bringup, model deploy (Redwood Private), monitoring & fallbacks, cost tuning, marketplace packaging.
Maya P.: Localization: we need translations for lab instructions and quiz. Target languages: en, fr, de. Who can coordinate?
Kevin L.: I'll ask the localization vendor. Budget ok? We have $4k in the partner ops line.
Jessie R.: FYI — SI Onboard Bot will post reminders and record completion status. SI Onboard Bot: "Reminder scheduled: training kickoff May 06 09:00 PT — invites going out."
Rahul S.: SLA question — do we offer post-cert 30-day support for integration issues? My team can do a 2-hr office hours weekly for 4 weeks.
Maya P.: Yes, offer a 30-day onboarding window with weekly office hours. We'll include a troubleshooting runbook. Jessie, can you add that to the syllabus?
Jessie R.: Will do. Also adding an item for telemetry access: token-scoped dashboards for SI engineers. Ops needs to whitelist.
Kevin L.: Marketing ask: co-branded one-pager and marketplace tile copy. I'll pull a draft and post in this thread by EOD tomorrow.
Maya P.: Action items recap: Rahul -> voucher region param + IP allowlist (72h). Jessie -> syllabus + runbook + quiz draft (tomorrow). Kevin -> marketing/legal sync + PR timeline + one-pager (EOD tomorrow). Maya -> finalize training agenda and invites (today). SI Onboard Bot: "Action summary posted to /docs/si/onboard/2024-orion/summary.md"
Jessie R.: small note — exam grading rubric: automated quiz (70% pass) + oral pass/fail. We'll keep grading decisions transparent.
Maya P.: Perfect. If no objections I'll lock training for May 6 and send invites in the next 2 hours.
Kevin L.: +1
Jessie R.: +1
Rahul S.: +1
Maya P.: Thanks team — will follow up with meeting invite and the tracking doc. :rocket:
